svg.title: NYC Payroll Analytics — End-to-End Azure Data Pipeline
svg.desc: Source CSV files land in ADLS Gen2 (dirpayrollfiles, dirhistoryfiles). Azure Data Factory runs three reference-data loads in parallel, then two payroll loads in parallel, into Azure SQL Database db_nycpayroll. A summary mapping data flow reads both payroll tables, normalizes AgencyCode to AgencyID, unions, filters by fiscal year, computes TotalPaid and aggregates by FiscalYear and AgencyName, then writes to the Azure SQL summary table and to CSV files in ADLS dirstaging. Synapse serverless SQL queries dirstaging through an external table.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Batch ELT on sample payroll data: ADLS Gen2 → Azure Data Factory mapping data flows → Azure SQL Database → ADLS staging → Synapse serverless SQL
